_comment: Manual status overrides. Status is normally DERIVED from git — merged to
develop = done, open PR = in-review, pushed branch = in-progress. Use this
file only when reality and git genuinely disagree.
Every override needs a reason. An override without one is how a plan starts
reporting what people wish were true.
Valid status values: todo | in-progress | in-review | done | blocked

A-001.reason: Maven multi-module skeleton (common/domain/api/worker) builds green; landed before the task-ID commit convention

A-002.reason: docker-compose.yml verified running MySQL 8.4 + Redis + MinIO + Mailpit; predates the task-ID commit convention

Supersedes the earlier hand-verification; commit subject said 'A011' without the hyphen

D-053.reason: Debashis — git read this as done off a branch that carried only the search half. **All three halves are now built (20 Aug).** Search shipped first; emoji once D-065 built the chat composer, needing no backend at all (chat_messages.body is utf8mb4, checked against the live column); file share last. The file-share half was recorded for months as needing a table-shape decision from Stream C. The shape chosen is a new chat_attachments table rather than a nullable ticket_attachments.ticket_id: that NOT NULL is load-bearing for C-025's scope check, C-028's delete window, C-060's cycle/stage grouping and the AV worker's claim query, and a chat file has no cycle, no stage, no client-visibility flag and no fifteen-minute window. The 'two answers to is-this-file-safe' worry is answered rather than overruled: AttachmentTypePolicy, ImageMetadataStripper and AttachmentScanner were already separate injectable beans, so chat calls the same three; only the storage key was ticket-shaped, and a StorageKey interface now covers both namespaces. Stream C's attachments package is touched for visibility only. Left as in-progress rather than done until the PR merges; the override exists because the git evidence for this task has been wrong since the first commit and would otherwise stay wrong.

D-037.reason: Debashis — git reads this as done off the merge of branch feat/engines/d-037-mail-events, and the branch was named for the task while carrying only D-030's mail body and one of the fifteen events. **Corrected 20 Aug: 14 of §4B.6's 15 rows now have a producer.** TicketEventNotifier wires six — created-and-assigned (TicketWriteService, C-067), comment added (CommentService, C-029), closed (CloseService, C-040), reopened (ReopenService, C-038), reassigned-within-a-stage (AssignService, C-049) and deployment-done (a forward hop out of a Deployment-owned stage, via C-045's HandoffNotifier). Live already elsewhere: handoff (HandoffNotifier, written by C-045 and deliberately left there), level raised to Critical, SLA breach, stage SLA breach, @mention and status requested. The last two rows are the digests and belong to D-038, which is done. **One row remains and it is not waiting on this stream: sent back for rework.** TransitionService understands REWORK, VERIFY_FAILED, DEPLOY_FAILED and SIGNOFF_REJECTED, and POST /tickets/{ticketId}/rework is in the contract and in the mock — but no controller serves it. The only two callers of advance are HandoffService, which hard-codes FORWARD, and ForceMoveService, which uses OVERRIDE, so nothing in the running application has ever moved a ticket backwards. That route is **C-046 (Divyansh, todo)**; when it lands this is one call at the end of it, and §4B.6 gives the list — Developer, cc PM. Kept blocked rather than closed at 14/15, because the task is stated as all fifteen and a green tick here would hide a mandatory mail that has never once been sent.

A-030.reason: Shivendra, PR #87 merged 2026-08-11 — features/auth/ with LoginPage, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, ChangePassword, authStore, RequireAuth and the strength meter, verified against the real stack (MySQL, Redis, packaged jar, Vite proxy with VITE_USE_MOCKS=false), and checked off in STREAM-A-PLATFORM.md. Commit subject carried no task ID and the merge subject only had the lowercase branch slug 'a-030', which the [A-D]-\d{3} pattern does not match
